title: NSW Digital Driver Licence (DDL) – Terms and Conditions
summary: This page outlines the terms and conditions for using the NSW Digital Driver Licence (DDL).
who_can_apply: Have or be able to obtain a MyServiceNSW account
Have or will link your MyServiceNSW account to your NSW driver licence
what_you_need: A DDL is evidence that you have been issued a NSW driver licence.
It is recommended to carry your plastic driver licence card as a backup, as the DDL may not be accepted by all retailers or venues.
A plastic NSW Driver Licence Card must be held at all times when you are driving outside of NSW.

faqs.q: Can I use the DDL if I am driving outside of NSW?
faqs.a: Yes, a plastic NSW Driver Licence Card must be held at all times when you are driving outside of NSW.

faqs.q: What should I do if I need to show my licence to a Police Officer?
faqs.a: Do not touch your mobile phone while in the driver’s seat of a motor vehicle until a Police Officer or other lawfully authorised person requests you to show your DDL.

faqs.q: What is my responsibility regarding my phone and DDL?
faqs.a: It is your responsibility to ensure that your phone is working, the battery is charged, and the screen is not cracked, otherwise your DDL will not be accepted.
